description: 경상북도_재난안전스마트시티통합플랫폼 강수현황 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상북도. 이러한 데이터는 침수 위험 관리, 도로 안전 점검, 현장 대응 판단 등 다양한 재난안전 행정 업무에서 중요한 기반 자료로 쓰이며, 기상 상황을 종합적으로 살피는 데 도움을 줍니다. Coverage: 경상북도. The portal files it under the publisher 경상북도. Its tags are 기상관측, 강우데이터, 재난대응, 침수위험, 강수량. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
